title.value: The use of artificial intelligence and virtual reality in doctor-patient risk communication: A scoping review
title.justification: The title is clearly stated at the beginning of the paper, and it defines the main focus of the research which is to review AI and VR applications in doctor-patient risk communication.
title.quote: The use of artificial intelligence and virtual reality in doctor-patient risk communication: A scoping review

extractions.description: This paper reviews the application of artificial intelligence (AI) and virtual reality (VR) in enhancing communication about risks between doctors and patients, particularly in a surgical context. It explores how these technologies can facilitate shared decision-making and improve patient outcomes by providing decision support tools, treatment visualizations, and communication training.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily deals with AI and VR applications in the medical field, specifically enhancing doctor-patient communication around surgical risks. This does not directly align with the provided eco-responsible categories.
primary_category.quote: Objectives: While the development of artificial intelligence (AI) and virtual reality (VR) technologies in medicine has been significant, their application to doctor-patient communication is limited.

secondary_categories.justification: The secondary applications discussed, such as decision support and treatment visualization, are extensions of the primary medical focus and also do not align with the eco-responsible categories provided.
secondary_categories.quote: Identified applications included decision support tools (15, 23.4%), tailored patient information resources (13, 20.3%), treatment visualization tools (17, 26.6%) and communication training platforms (19, 29.7%).

primary_sub_category.justification: As the paper does not fit into any listed eco-responsible sub-categories, 'N/A' is chosen for the sub-category as well.
primary_sub_category.quote: There is emerging literature regarding applications of AI and VR to facilitate doctor-patient surgical risk communication.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: There are no sub-categories related to the medical focus of this paper in the provided eco-responsible list.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Practice implications: AI and VR hold the potential to personalize doctor-patient surgical risk communication to individual patients and healthcare contexts.
